note: FY2568 historical-baseline target contract for Category 3. The FY2568 KPI/target table (ในหมวดที่ 3 เป้าหมายและตัวชี้วัด และ มาตรการ 68.docx) sets a 1% year-over-year reduction target vs 2024 for electricity, fuel, water, and paper (green procurement >60% belongs to Cat6). These target clauses are cross-indicator by nature (they feed every 3.x.x data indicator), so records reference the category-level evidence entry ev-cat3-targets-measures-fy2568 and declare empty indicatorCodes. Target outcomes are shown as met/not-met context in data.json — never as a score. No FY2569 facts.
